title: pvANLSubhaloFinder
body:
## pvANLSubhaloFinder

Runs the CosmoTools subhalo finder (vtkPANLSubhaloFinder) on halos already found by pvANLHaloFinder: the input is that filter's port 0 particles with vx, vy, vz, id and fof_halo_tag. Port 0 returns the particles with a subhalo_tag array (-1 outside subhalos) and port 1 one point per subhalo with mass, centre of mass, mean velocity and velocity dispersion. Mode chooses all halos, halos larger than SizeThreshold, or only the halo ids in HalosToProcess.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Feed it pvANLHaloFinder output port 0; plain particle data lack fof_halo_tag.
- Use the same Boxsize, Seedparticles and ParticleMass as the halo finder.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `ANLSubhaloFinder`. Identity: `filters/ANLSubhaloFinder`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `Input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. ParaView: This property specifies the input of the filter. Accepted data: unstructured grids (vtkUnstructuredGrid). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkUnstructuredGrid"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `AlphaFactor` | A tuning parameter of subhalo finding. This controls how aggressively small suhalos will be grown. Alpha factor of 1.0 is the least agrressive. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `BetaFactor` | A tuning parameter of subhalo finding. This controls how saddle points between subhalos are treated. Larger values allow identification of smaller scale structures such as tails. | `{"maximum":1.0,"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `Boxsize` | The box side length used to wrap particles around if they exceed rL (or less than 0) in any dimension (only positive positions are allowed in the input, or they are wrapped around). | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `HalosToProcess` | This list of halo ids which will be processed (if they exist in the data) by the filter when in 'Only Specified Halos' mode. | `{"items":{"minimum":0,"type":"integer"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[0]` |
| `Linkinglength` | Linking length measured in units of interparticle spacing and is dimensionless. Used to link particles into halos for the friends-of-friends (FOF) algorithm. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `MinimumSubhaloSize` | A subhalo candidate must have at least this many particles to be a subhalo. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Mode` | This property specifies which halos the filter will process. When 'All Halos' is selected, all input halos will be processed. When 'Only Halos Larger Than Threshold' is selected, only halos with more than SizeThreshold particles will be processed. When 'Only Specified Halos' is selected, the halos whose ids are in the HalosToProcess list will be used. | `{"type":"enum","values":["All Halos","Halos Larger Than Threshold","Only Specified Halos"]}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `"All Halos"` |
| `NumberofNeighbors` | The nearest X particles will be used to determine the local density in the subhalo finder where X is the value of this parameter. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `Overlap` | The space (in rL units) to extend processor particle ownership for ghost particles/cells. Needed for correct halo calculation when halos cross processor boundaries in parallel computation. Called DeadSize in the hacc config files. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `ParticleMass` | The mass of each particle. | `{"minimum":0.0,"type":"number"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `0.0` |
| `SPHNeighbors` | A parameter of the subhalo finder. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `SizeThreshold` | This is the minimum size of a halo that will be processed if the filter is in 'Halos Larger Than Threshold' mode. | `{"minimum":1,"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvANLSubhaloFinder",
  "inputs": {
    "Input": "UPSTREAM_Input"
  }
}
```
